title: Q-GROW-PILOT-OFFER: GROW-3: a priced pilot offer as data, shown on the pilot page
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order (growth items first when the recent growth share is below target)
**Done check:** file:doctrine/pilot-offer.json
**Status:** open

Owner directive 2026-11-12: product management is growth, not only bug fixes. Growth item: it adds a capability, a surface, a reader or a customer path.

Write doctrine/pilot-offer.json: who the pilot is for (the four system-test questions), what the pilot includes (tenant on the same shape, objectives, metrics, loops, a monthly budget), a first monthly price hypothesis with its range, and how the price is revised from measured pilot cost (model calls, compute, storage). Render it on /pilot. The system chooses the default price; changing it is a reviewed PR with a revert.
Paths: doctrine/pilot-offer.json, site/worker.js, site/site.test.mjs.
Acceptance: /pilot shows the offer and price from the data file; a test fails if the page and the file disagree.
Metric moved: pilot applications. Prediction: stated price raises application quality (all four system-test answers present) from the current baseline.

size: M

**Closing probe:** file:doctrine/pilot-offer.json and the stated metric measured after the change (keep only if the target moved and no guard worsened).
